name: bt_miwear_ipc_instance

ownership.argument: Process-lifetime MiWear Bluetooth IPC client created by firmware boot. Its +56 word is the business libuv loop that must run synchronous GAP IPC, and +48 holds the adapter state (4 = ready). Stock scan, advertising and payment/unlock callers use this instance; the module only adds its own adapter callback registration.

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.139 image/IDB, compared with xiaomi-band-11-4.100.155: 62 matched functions load this address from the same instruction position as the .155 callers, so the object keeps its .bss slot in this build.

notes: Address catalogue for module verification and ABI documentation only. Not a public ownership grant.
